## Type of issue

- [ ] Incorrect frequency
- [ ] Outdated diagram
- [ ] Spelling / typo
- [ ] Broken link
- [ ] General improvement or suggestion
- [ ] Other

## Page or section concerned

Link to the affected page on [doc.vatsim.fr](https://doc.vatsim.fr/) (or the section name if no direct link is available).

## Description

Describe the issue clearly. What is wrong, missing, or outdated?

## Suggested fix (optional)

If you already have a correction in mind (updated frequency, diagram, wording, etc.), include it here.

## Additional context (optional)

Screenshots, references, or anything else that helps us understand the issue.
